test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **investing.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blanks is **investing.**
 
• The word** investing** means **put (money) into financial schemes, shares, property, or a commercial venture with the expectation of achieving a profit.**
 
 
• Example- I have been **investing** my money in a bank since 2014.
 
 
 
• Thus the appropriate option is investing.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Spending **means **money or financial resources expended by a person, group, or government.**
 
• The word **expanding **means** giving a sense of heightened or broader awareness.**
 
• The word** spreading** means **open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.**
